jobs_results.description:
About the Role
This is a rare chance to learn data science from the inside out at one of the fastest-growing healthcare startups in the country. As an Associate Data Scientist at Solace, you'll work on the forecasting and machine learning systems that operate our marketplace in real time: matching patients with advocates, predicting demand, and keeping the business ahead of its own growth.


You won't spend your first year re-deriving textbook exercises. You'll contribute to real models with mentorship from senior data scientists, and you'll be expected to think independently, question your own results, and defend your methodology. You don't need years of experience, but you do need an innate ability to get things done.


This role is for the ambitious, the curious, and those who don't shy away from feedback. If you're the kind of person who sees a problem and can't resist solving it, keep reading.


This is an in person role in our Redwood City office, 3 days a week.


What You'll Do
Contribute to real predictive models in your first weeks: forecasting, matching, and scoring systems that the business runs on.


Pull and wrangle your own data with SQL from Snowflake. Nobody hands you a clean CSV here.


Support the design and analysis of A/B tests and experiments, learning how to measure the true impact of product and operational changes.


Work alongside data engineers to see how models get from a notebook into production, learning MLOps practices as you go.


Apply statistics with rigor: knowing when a result is real, when it's noise, and how to tell the difference.


Present your findings and defend your methodology to technical and non-technical audiences. Your voice matters here, even on day one.


Grow your craft: learn how to frame problems, validate models, design experiments, and make smart modeling decisions.


What You Bring to the Table
A bachelor's or master's degree in Statistics, Data Science, Computer Science, Applied Math, or a related quantitative field (or equivalent practical experience), graduating between December 2026 and June 2027.


Strong fundamentals in statistics and probability: hypothesis testing, regression, and the judgment to know when your model is fooling you.


Working Python skills, including the core data science ecosystem (pandas, scikit-learn, NumPy), plus working SQL.


Projects that show you can do real quantitative work: research, internships, Kaggle competitions, hackathons, or personal modeling projects. We care about what you've built and what you learned from it, not just what you studied.


A bias toward action. You have an exceptional craving for momentum, and you'd rather ship a simple model that works than polish a complex one that never launches.


Curiosity for how systems work, comfort with ambiguity, and a refined palate for controlled chaos.


Confident communication. You can explain a model to someone who has never heard of one, and take critique of your methodology without defensiveness.


A sense of care. You take pride in the details, because in healthcare data, the details are the difference.


A hunger to learn and an ego small enough to admit when you don't know something.


Bonus Points
Exposure to time-series forecasting (ARIMA, Prophet, exponential smoothing).


Coursework or projects in causal inference or experimental design.


Familiarity with dbt, Airflow, Docker, or cloud environments (AWS).


Experience with NLP or unstructured text data.


Up for the Challenge?
We look forward to meeting you.

jobs_results.job_title: Data Scientist  (Remote from Anywhere in Colorado)
jobs_results.description:
Together, we innovate for a stronger Colorado
The work of employees at the Governor's Office of Information Technology (OIT) is challenging and diverse because the needs of agencies, customers and Coloradans constantly evolve. But our focus never changes: improve the lives of all Coloradans through innovation and collaboration. We're building one of the nation's leading government IT organizations by reimagining how we support agencies, building first-of-their-kind applications, and creating an inclusive, collaborative culture, together. Join us in the important work of providing equitable access to services.


Watch this video to learn more about how we're Serving People. Serving Colorado.
IMPORTANT NOTE: Please review your application to ensure completion. For the most equitable applicant experience, OIT’s hiring team considers only the contents of your application to review your qualifications. Please do not include any attachments (such as resume or cover letter) with your application as these items are not used by OIT’s hiring team.  




Are you looking for an opportunity to apply your domain knowledge in education and workforce development with your keen analytic skills? If so, join us in making a meaningful impact in Colorado through innovative data analytics. As our new Data Scientist, you will be a key contributor in leveraging data to drive strategic business decisions for Colorado’s Statewide Longitudinal Data System (SLDS), known as COdata. In this role, you will have the opportunity to employ advanced analytics techniques using modern data tools such as Snowflake, Python, SQL, R, and Tableau, as you conduct comprehensive data analysis spanning descriptive, diagnostic, and predictive methodologies. 


You will closely collaborate with the Data Architects, Data Engineers, Data Visualization Developers, Senior Management, OIT leadership, and agency stakeholders to develop sophisticated data visualizations, automated reporting processes, and actionable insights that inform and improve business outcomes. If using your creativity and innovation in the development and delivery of impactful data initiatives is what you love, apply today for the chance to also put your passion into the state you love! 


Some of the key responsibilities include:


Design useful education to career research questions and appropriate quantitative methods to inform policy and practice.


Conduct quantitative research on administrative data sets. 


Write research reports, briefs, infographics and slides deck to convey results. 


Design, maintain and optimize visualization dashboards in Tableau.


Combining data from multiple sources to produce meaningful metrics.


Identify data patterns, trends and communicate those key insights as recommended actions to key audiences .


Developing and maintaining complex dashboards and reports using Tableau, visualizing data sourced from Snowflake and other data repositories.


Communicating complex data insights and analytical findings to technical and non-technical stakeholders effectively.


Ensuring data quality and governance standards are met within the Snowflake environment.


Utilizing Python and SQL to extract, transform, and load (ETL) within Snowflake for analysis.


Working with resource managers and stakeholders to identify and integrate new data sources.


Leading and participating in cross-functional teams to develop data-driven solutions.


Present information and findings in a way that is accessible to both SLDS staff and the general public.


Oversee the production, display, and development of data structures and analytics for the Colorado SLDS.


Ensure data privacy and security in alignment with CISO guidelines. 


A wide salary range is posted for this position and any job offer is based upon a salary analysis to comply with the Colorado Equal Pay for Equal Work Act. The salary analysis considers relevant experience, education, certifications, and state seniority as compared to others doing substantially similar work. While all offers are compliant with the Colorado Equal Pay for Equal Work Act, there is no guarantee an offer will be at the top of the posted range based on the salary analysis. 

This is a skills-based job announcement. The required minimum qualifications and/or education (if substituting for the proven experience, knowledge, and skills), are as follows: 

Minimum Qualifications:


A minimum of five (5) years working experience as a Data Analyst in the public sector of either education or workforce development, with significant expertise in using Snowflake, Python, SQL, R, and Tableau.


A minimum of three (3) years of experience developing dashboards using data reporting tools (Tableau - preferred, Power BI, R Shiny or PyShiny).

Deep understanding of applied research methods, specifically program evaluation and quantitative data analysis of longitudinal in the public sector data. 

At least five (5) years experience working with education and/or workforce data. 

Experience in conducting descriptive, diagnostic, and predictive data analysis in the public sector.


Strong understanding of data modeling, database management, SQL, and ETL processes in the public sector.



Substitutions:

Additional appropriate education will substitute for the required experience on a year-for-year basis, but cannot completely substitute for these qualifications. 

Training or Certification related to the work assigned to the position will be assigned credit towards substitution for experience and/or education, but cannot completely substitute for these qualifications. 

If the minimum qualifications include a degree requirement, additional appropriate paid or unpaid experience will substitute for the required education on a year-for-year basis.


Preferred Qualifications:


Domain knowledge of education to career data and analyses.


Experience working for an SLDS.


Experience working for a governmental organization. 


Experience designing, building, implementing, and maintaining data and system integrations and data transformations utilizing Snowflake.


Familiarity with data governance frameworks and tools, including Informatica.


Knowledge of other cloud platforms like AWS, GCP  or Azure.



Conditions of Employment:

OIT employees must comply with any screening procedures in place at state agency locations where they might perform work. 

A pre-employment background check will be conducted as part of the selection process. Post-employment background checks will be required for specific agencies as business needs dictate, which may include a polygraph exam, fingerprint-based criminal history search, reference checks, and a drug test.

This position may require travel within the specified geographic area, and to locations across the state as needed. 

If this posting indicates “remote from anywhere in CO” in the title, periodic reporting to the primary state work location designated for the position is required. All remote work must be performed in Colorado. 


While candidates from out of state will be considered for this role, the candidate selected for the position must relocate and reside in Colorado on the first day of their new position.  A reasonable timeframe for relocation will be established on an individual basis, while considering business needs, and determining a start date.



We know it's important to support each other, and that means having a healthy balance of work and personal time. Visit our benefits to learn more about some of our great offerings that allow us all to have fulfilling lives. 


Visit our How to Apply webpage to learn more about our application process and what to expect after you apply.

jobs_results.description:
Radiance Technologies, a rapidly growing employee-owned company, is seeking an experienced Data Scientist to support the U.S. Army Space and Missile Defense Command (USASMDC) at Peterson Space Force Base in Colorado Springs, Colorado. This position supports an ongoing, mission-critical effort focused on advancing data analytics capabilities in support of national security missions. The effort is funded on an annual basis, with the current period of performance extending through July 31, 2027, and future work anticipated to be supported through subsequent annual funding. The selected candidate will apply advanced data analytics techniques to research and analyze structured and unstructured data, develop complex database queries, and transform data into actionable insights. Working as part of a multidisciplinary team, the Data Scientist will collaborate with Government and contractor personnel to integrate diverse data sources, solve complex mission challenges, and communicate analytical findings and recommendations to stakeholders.

Duties and Responsibilities

 •   Perform research on structured and unstructured data sources using quantitative and qualitative metadata and content analytics.

 •   Construct and execute complex database queries to support mission requirements.

 •   Collaborate across multidisciplinary teams to integrate data sources and solve mission challenges.

 •   Identify meaningful insights from large datasets and communicate findings and recommendations to Government stakeholders.

 •   Support data management activities within large-scale, enterprise data environments.

Required Qualifications

 •   Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or another relevant STEM discipline (or equivalent experience).

 •   Five (5) or more years of experience as a Data Scientist or in a closely related analytical role.

 •   Demonstrated knowledge of computer science concepts, data architecture, intelligence practices, and managing data within big-data environments.

 •   Experience performing complex data analysis and database queries.

 •   Active Top Secret/SCI security clearance.

Position Duration

This position supports an ongoing customer mission with funding anticipated on an annual basis. The current period of performance extends through July 31, 2027, with continued performance anticipated subject to future funding and customer requirements. While future funding cannot be guaranteed, Radiance intends to support the continuing mission as funding is made available. Employees may also pursue other opportunities within Radiance Technologies for which they are qualified.

Salary Range

$150,000 - $175,000

Radiance Technologies is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or protected veteran status.

Who we areAbout StripeStripe is a technology company focused on improving the conditions for economic growth and prosperity. We build programmable financial infrastructure, rethinking from first principles how financial services should work, to make it easier and cheaper for any business to start and scale. More than 10 million businesses build on Stripe, spanning the economic frontier—from solo founders to established enterprises—united by a practical focus on growth. The most ambitious companies in the world use Stripe as core infrastructure to grow faster. They process trillions of dollars a year on Stripe, equivalent to around 1.6% of global GDP. While economic growth makes everyone better off, open markets also enable greater variety. When any business can easily serve a global customer base, the quality and diversity of products in the world increase, and craft and creativity are unleashed into the smallest niches. Our own growth is wholly contingent on the success of the businesses building on Stripe. We therefore invest back into our technology at an unusual rate. We make upgrades to our products every single day to deliver compounding gains to our customers. We maintain some of the most reliable APIs on the internet. We build entirely new pieces of financial infrastructure to enable new ideas. And our significant advances in risk and fraud infrastructure over many years are making the internet economy safer and more accessible.

Though people at Stripe don’t tend to take themselves seriously, Stripe is a fairly serious place: our customers are depending on us for their livelihoods. We admire ambition, intensity, curiosity, humility, and rigor. The most effective people become knowledgeable about many domains besides their own. Any company is an applied exercise in understanding some aspect of society or the market. In working with so many (especially the new and innovative ones), we think that Stripe is one of the very best places to learn about how the world works.

Our Fraud, Losses, and Financial Crime Data Science team builds the models and data products that protect Stripe and its users from fraud, account takeover, and financial crime. We own the full fraud and loss modeling stack - from account takeover detection and card fraud classification to merchant-level loss estimation, unsupervised anomaly detection, and financial crime risk modeling. jobs_results.description:
PakEnergy is accelerating its innovation. Help us lead it.
 
 
  More than 2,300 oil and gas companies run their land, production, accounting and transportation on PakEnergy. We've started putting AI to work across that platform. Now we're accelerating our pace of innovation, and we're building the PakEnergy Innovation Lab to do it.
 
 
 
  The Lab's mandate is simple: find the highest-value problems our customers face, prove solutions quickly with working prototypes built on real operational energy data, and take what works into production. We're hiring a Lead Data Scientist to be the founding owner of data science and machine learning on the Lab's cross-functional team, reporting directly to our Chief Product Officer. This is a hands-on lead role: you'll build the models and write the code yourself while setting direction for the discipline. You'll have real autonomy. You own the data science approach on Lab projects, help shape the opportunity backlog with the Chief Product Officer and the industry experts, and make the call, backed by evidence, when an idea should stop. We value candor over polish: a fast, well-reasoned "this won't work" is a good outcome. Our data spans several product platforms, and part of the job is spotting the data gaps that limit what we can ship and helping close them.
 
 
 
  
   What we've already shipped with Pak AI
  
  
   AI-powered lease provision analysis (PakEnergy Land). Embedded AI that flags key lease provisions in seconds instead of hours, so land teams can manage large portfolios and acquisitions faster.
   PakCAPTURE™ (PakEnergy Transportation). Drivers photograph tickets, receipts and paperwork in the mobile app. Pak AI extracts the key data, auto-populates pickup and drop-off forms, and files the documents with the right load.
   OnPing Plunger™ (OnPing). Optimization for plunger-lift wells. Pak AI learns each well's best historical runs, compares actual against expected performance, and tunes setpoints within the operator's automation and safety limits, or flags the well for human review. It has delivered up to 30% more production on conservatively set wells and 3.5–7% on wells that were already well optimized.
  
  
   These are the first steps. The Innovation Lab is where the next ones get found, proven and shipped.
  
  
  
   
    The team
   
   
    The Innovation Lab brings together everyone it takes to go from a customer problem to a working product:
    Industry experts for every PakEnergy product: Land, Production, Accounting and Transportation. They know the workflows, the data and the customers firsthand.
    A Lead Applied AI Engineer, your peer, who designs and builds the Lab's generative AI, LLM and agentic systems and gets them into production.
    Solution engineers who take prototypes to customers and into production.
    You, the Lab's founding owner of data science and machine learning.
    For a strong data scientist, this means you won't get requirements secondhand, you won't build in a vacuum, and there's a clear path from your model to a customer. Domain experts frame problems with you, your peer lead in applied AI builds the generative AI side, and solution engineers put the results in customers' hands.
   
   
   
    Why this role
   
   
    Founding owner of your discipline. You'll set the technical direction, standards and practices for data science in the Lab from day one, and help shape what the Lab works on.
    Real operational energy data. You'll work with SCADA and IIoT time series from OnPing, lease and contract documents, revenue and joint-interest accounting, and the tickets and paperwork behind every load hauled, across a customer base of more than 2,300 companies.
    Deep expertise around you. You'll work next to industry experts for every product, a peer lead in applied AI and solution engineers, so you can focus on the data science while the team brings domain depth and a route to customers.
    Ownership from prototype to production. You own the data science from problem framing through modeling and evaluation, and see it through customer pilots into production.
    A direct line to leadership. You report to the Chief Product Officer, and your work shapes the Pak AI roadmap.
    A path to leading a team. There are no direct reports today. As Innovation Lab initiatives mature and demonstrate value, this role is set up to help build and lead the Lab's data science team.
   
   
   
    What you'll do
   
   
    Frame problems with the industry experts. Partner with the Lab's Land, Production, Accounting and Transportation experts to turn customer pain points into well-defined, measurable data science problems, and size the opportunity.
    Own the modeling. Build forecasting, anomaly detection, optimization and predictive models on production, SCADA/IIoT, accounting, transportation and geospatial data, from exploratory analysis through working prototype.
    Experiment and evaluate rigorously. Design experiments, offline evaluations and pilot success metrics. Own the evidence on whether something works, and recommend when an idea should stop.
    Partner with the Lead Applied AI Engineer on GenAI and agentic work. They design and build the Lab's LLM, document AI and agentic systems. You bring the data, lead evaluation design, and contribute ML and statistical models those systems can use.
    Take it to customers and production with solution engineers. Partner on customer pilots, and for the ML models you own, define the data, monitoring and MLOps requirements for a clean handoff to product and engineering teams.
    Stay accountable after deployment. Partner with engineering teams on production monitoring, model performance, drift detection and continuous improvement for the models you own after handoff.
    Set the technical direction for data science. Define the Lab's data science approach, tooling and standards for data quality, experimentation, reproducibility and responsible ML, and raise data fluency across a cross-functional team.
    Build the foundation for a future team. Document how data science works in the Lab, mentor and coach teammates, and shape the roles and hiring plan for when the Lab expands.
   
   
   
    
     What you bring
    
    
     8+ years in applied ML or data science, including multiple models you built and shipped to production, used by real customers.
     A track record of setting technical direction for data science work: choosing the approaches, tooling and standards that others adopted.
     Experience mentoring, coaching or leading other data scientists or engineers, formally or as a technical lead.
     Depth in at least one of time-series forecasting, anomaly detection or optimization on noisy, real-world data, with strong grounding in statistics, experimental design and model evaluation.
     Expert Python and SQL. You're still hands-on and build the models yourself.
     Working knowledge of LLM and GenAI systems, especially how to evaluate them (test-set design, metrics, human labeling, error analysis), enough to be a strong technical partner to the Lab's Lead Applied AI Engineer.
     Experience working within lightweight, fast-moving software development practices that prioritize rapid experimentation, testing, customer validation and responsible production delivery.
     A track record of turning ambiguous problems into shipped products with domain experts, product and engineering, influencing executives and stakeholders along the way, and the candor to say when something won't work.
    
    
     Nice to have
    
    
     Oil and gas, energy or industrial domain experience is a plus, not a requirement. The Lab's industry experts bring deep knowledge of every PakEnergy product, and you'll learn the domain working beside them.
     Experience with SCADA/IIoT or geospatial data, or with labeling and evaluating document-extraction systems.
     Databricks, Spark, Azure and/or AWS, and MLflow or similar MLOps tooling.
     Experience hiring data scientists or building a data science function from an early stage.

The core mandate is to evolve the organization from reactive moderation and lagging harm reporting into a proactive, metrics-driven operating system—where we manage leading indicators that predict risk, improve understanding quality, and keep Pinterest safe, inspiring, and useful.

jobs_results.description:
At Netflix, our mission is to entertain the world. Together, we are writing the next episode - pushing the boundaries of storytelling, global fandom and making the unimaginable a reality. We are a dream team obsessed with the uncomfortable excitement of discovering what happens when you merge creativity, intuition and cutting-edge technology. Come be a part of what’s next.

  


Netflix Animation Studios (NAS) is Netflix's in-house feature animation studio, delivering the exceptional artistry behind big hits like Leo, KPop Demon Hunters, and The Sea Beast. 

  


Media Science DSE is hiring for an embedded role to stand up our data science capability within NAS. How well NAS plans for and manages its growing slate and workforce has a direct impact on the creative and financial success of its films. As a Data Scientist, you'll construct and execute the roadmap for analysis, models, and data products that connect finance, production, and people data into a single system empowering slate planning, operational forecasting, and strategic decision-making for the Studio. You'll work directly with NAS leadership across Studio Operations and Production to architect the robust data foundations NAS needs to scale its slate with confidence.

  


As a Senior Data Scientist in this space, you will…

  * Serve as NAS's founding data scientist, partnering with leadership to define and prioritize the studio's metrics & science agenda
  * Strategically thought partner to scope ambiguous, greenfield questions - proposing and delivering analysis and science that introduce and influence data-informed ways of thinking
  * Own the end-to-end measurement agenda in partnership with data engineering - spanning data model design; new metric development, analysis, and forecasting; and the interpretation and dissemination of results
  * Conduct slate analysis that surfaces drivers of show efficiency as a means to preserve creative optionality across shows
  * Develop scenario planning models that quantify how schedule changes ripple across the production slate - giving leadership the visibility they need to proactively manage production timelines and workforce allocation
  * Build dashboards and scorecards that allow leadership to continuously monitor show statuses and potential risks
  * Present your metrics, models, and analytical insights clearly to a leadership audience, translating complex analysis into decisions NAS can act on
  * Collaborate with data scientists, analytics engineers, and data engineers across Media Science DSE to apply existing metric and viz approaches to NAS, where appropriate

  


About you…

  * Advanced degree in Statistics, Applied Mathematics, Economics, Operations Research, or a related quantitative field (or equivalent practical experience)
  * 8+ years of experience as a data scientist, with a track record of developing and executing measurement frameworks, models, and visualization products that directly inform business decisions
  * Experience building scenario planning, forecasting, or optimization models in operationally complex, resource-constrained environments
  * Strong quantitative and statistical intuition, comfortable moving fluidly between exploratory analysis, new metric construction, model development, and applied problem solving
  * Proven ability to translate ambiguous business questions into structured analytical workstreams
  * Skilled at building dashboards and visualizations that make complex data intuitive and actionable for a business leadership audience
  * Excellent verbal and written communicator who is adept at distilling complex analysis into clear, digestible narratives that broad audiences can understand and act on - influencing data-informed thinking across the organization
  * Comfortable operating with minimal oversight in a fast-paced, evolving environment
  * Energized by the opportunity to work within a film studio and build a new data science capability from the ground up
  * Netflix culture resonates with you
